description: Scope is deliberately limited to CI: action pins in .github/workflows and .github/actions, plus the tool versions those actions install.
Helm charts are managed separately: enabling the helmv3/helm-values managers would raise PRs that change charts/** without bumping Chart.yaml, which ct lint rejects.

customManagers.description: Tool versions passed as action inputs (helm, git-cliff, python). These are invisible to the github-actions manager, which only tracks 'uses:' digests - annotate a pin with '# renovate: datasource=X depName=Y' to have it watched.

packageRules.description: Group non-major action updates into a single PR
Majors get their own PR and must be approved on the dependency dashboard first, so input-schema and runtime changes are reviewed deliberately

azure/setup-helm controls which Helm binary CI runs. The OCI release action passes a full https:// URL to 'helm registry login', which only works on Helm 3, so this must never be bumped without checking the pinned 'version:' inputs.
Group non-major tool version bumps (helm, git-cliff, python)
Major tool version bumps are reviewed deliberately

Helm 3 pins must stay on Helm 3. The OCI release action runs 'helm registry login https://...', and Helm 4 accepts a bare domain only - moving these to 4.x breaks chart publishing until REGISTRY_URL drops the scheme. The lint-helm4 job's v4 pin is unaffected by this rule.
